in_sanskrit.name: अविजित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Avijit is derived from the Sanskrit words 'avij' (unconquered) and 'it' (he, him). It is a name that signifies victory over all challenges and adversities. In Hindu mythology, Avijit is the name of the god of immortality, who is believed to grant longevity and protection to his devotees.

in_hindi.name: अविजित
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Avijit in Hindi is formed by combining the words 'ajit' (unconquered) and 'vi' (he, him). It is a name that reflects the strength and courage of the one who bears it, and signifies victory over all challenges and adversities.

in_tamil.name: அவிஜித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Avijit in Tamil is derived from the words 'avar' (he, him) and 'jith' (victory). It is a name that signifies the one who is victorious in all his endeavors and is unconquered by any challenges or adversities.

in_telugu.name: అవిజిట్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Avijit in Telugu is formed by combining the words 'avadhesh' (unconquerable, invincible) and 'jit' (he, him). It is a name that reflects the strength and courage of the one who bears it, and signifies victory over all challenges and adversities.

in_marathi.name: Avijit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avijit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avijit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Avijit' which means 'new' or 'fresh'. It is a name given to a child born in new circumstances, or to mark a new beginning in life. In Hindu mythology, Avijit is the name of the god of new beginnings and prosperity. He is believed to bestow good luck and fortune upon his devotees.
